native_contract: Constructor allocates/constructs Array<Vector*> then stores its pointer at Gun+0xac before the same five ArraySetLength calls. Removing the intermediate non-owning local preserves allocation, exception cleanup and effects. Collision native sub #25 / CLZ / LSR #5 returns a zero flag. Let d=uint32(kind)-25 and w=(uint64(d)<<32)|0x80000000. w is always nonzero. If d==0, clz64(w)=32; otherwise clz64(w) is 0..31. Right shift 5 therefore equals kind==25 for every 32-bit kind, with defined unsigned arithmetic and no clz(0).
